text:
Type: silver picture frame with mat
Use: displaying photos, prints or artwork on a wall or shelf; living room, bedroom, hallway, home office
Style: classic, contemporary, glam
Materials: frame in a brushed silver finish with a rounded profile, white mat board, clear glazing
Colors: silver, white, light grey insert
Shape: upright rectangle with a medium rounded molding and soft beveled inner edge, wide white mat around the picture, light visual weight
Feel: elegant, cool, polished
Goes with: grey or white walls, chrome, glass, black and white photos; classic, contemporary or glam rooms

product.name: SILVERHJDEN
